description: Which Android phones are paired with this computer (each one's device id, model and CodeDroid server), whether CodeDroid on each is connected, and if not, why and how to fix it. Also retries the connection. Once connected it returns the phones' instructions for driving them. Pass device for one phone alone.

device.description: Which paired phone runs this: its id, or its model or part of it, as codedroid_devices lists them. Required when several phones are paired.

name: codedroid_status
title: CodeDroid connection
